scope: Ten first-page public GitHub searches followed by six purposive pinned source triages. Separate from all earlier FakeGit samples.

source_signal_outcomes.observed: Credential theft terms occurred in a scanner's detection table and research references.
source_signal_outcomes.assessment: Defensive documentation signal; not an observed stealing instruction.

source_signal_outcomes.observed: A provider plugin's token handling supports a loopback bridge and explicit upstream request forwarding. Its package has no install lifecycle hook; inspected forwarding code rejects redirects.
source_signal_outcomes.assessment: Declared functionality in inspected source. No covert external credential destination established.

source_signal_outcomes.observed: Credential provisioning instructions activate on the user's setup request, write local MCP configuration and describe optional checks against the selected service.
source_signal_outcomes.assessment: Explicit credential setup; not an observed unsolicited secret upload.

source_signal_outcomes.observed: An MCP code-review tool sends chosen source to its configured service, but the public call path rejects secret-named target files before building their context.
source_signal_outcomes.assessment: The searched secret-name and network strings do not establish a stealing chain.

source_signal_outcomes.observed: Two base64 hook wrappers decode to local command rewriting and local token-budget logging helpers.
source_signal_outcomes.assessment: Encoding alone did not establish malicious behavior. No credential collection or network upload observed in those inspected wrappers/helpers.

source_signal_outcomes.observed: Webhook instructions send an explicit message body to a user-created callback URL, limit lifetimes/deliveries and treat external bodies as untrusted.
source_signal_outcomes.assessment: Disclosed callback functionality; no automatic local credential collection shown by inspected material.

limits: Search-result rows and total-match counters are not audited-repository or malware counts.
The recent date bounds apply to the two repository-discovery queries; code searches were global default-branch searches without that date filter.
Seventeen text files were retrieved for focused source tracing, not every line of every dependency or every release artifact.
No installation, execution, live endpoint test, victim telemetry or complete benign certification was performed.
Zero established candidates in this selected set does not prove the wider discovery pool is safe.
No linkage to FakeGit, ClawHavoc, or any other campaign is inferred from keywords, encoding or shared tooling.
identity_policy: Source targets remain anonymous in this summary. Exact refs and source receipts are retained privately.
publication_status: Prepared for owner review; not published.
phase_scope: Search and pinned-source observations on 2026-10-09. Later acquisitions and pure-data analyses are separately recorded in static-analysis.json; they do not retroactively change this source-pass denominator.
